# Kimi-K2.7-Code tokenizer parity corpus (one case per line).
#   - a line starting with '#' is a comment
#   - \n, \t and \\ in a line are unescaped to a newline, a tab and a backslash
#     by tools/kimi_tokenizer_capture.py, so multi-line text fits one line
# Every case is encoded by the checkpoint's own tokenizer (tiktoken with Kimi's
# pat_str) and by the engine's bridge; ids must match exactly.
# ASCII words and contractions
The capital of France is
don't stop, it's 3.14% of the total...
# code and punctuation
def f(x):\n    return x**2 + 1\n
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 10;
json {"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": null}
# whitespace runs
  leading and trailing   
\tTabbed\tline
# non-Latin
Переменная = 42
变量名 = 42 中文测试
emoji 🚀 test ünïcode
# long repeats (BPE depth)
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
# chat control markers (special + non-special)
<|im_user|>user<|im_middle|>hi<|im_end|>
<|tool_call_begin|>functions.get_weather:0<|tool_call_argument_begin|>{"city":"Paris"}<|tool_call_end|>
<think>reasoning</think>answer
